title: Camera Fundamentals
description: Core principles of how a camera captures light, forms an image, and supports storytelling intent.
summary: Camera fundamentals cover the imaging chain—optics, sensor, exposure triangle, framing, and capture settings—so every technical choice serves story, brand, and delivery.
